name: 22405 · Fredericksbrg, VA
findings: ZIP 22405 (Fredericksbrg) has 108 nonprofit organizations. 55 of them (51%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 44 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (37% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 22405 (Fredericksbrg) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
